content.text: The real SendFn surface is narrower than the generated inventory: the public client supports template registry reads/writes, communication sends, delivery-event queries, suppression management, and device-token management. I’m removing the fictional provider/domain/contact/webhook/usage resources and marking each mutation by its actual idempotency and risk behavior.
